Description
 Join our team building AI-powered product classification systems at Amazon scale. Your code will directly impact millions of products and sellers worldwide, automating compliance workflows and reducing seller friction through better classification accuracy and transparency.
Are you passionate about solving complex engineering challenges that blend machine learning, distributed systems, and regulatory compliance? We're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build classification systems that automatically identify product compliance requirements, explain decisions to sellers, and streamline the marketplace experience.
Key job responsibilities
 Design, develop, and maintain scalable distributed systems using AWS, Java, and Python
 Build and optimize classification pipelines that process millions of product classifications
 Implement features that help sellers understand compliance decisions and take actionable steps
 Collaborate with science teams to productionize machine learning models including graph neural networks and large language models
 Develop APIs and integrations that connect classification systems with seller-facing tools and compliance workflows
 A day in the life
You might start your day reviewing system metrics, then work on improving APIs or building new features for compliance tools. You'll collaborate with applied scientists on machine learning integration, work with product managers on requirements, and partner with compliance teams on system design.
Your work contributes to more efficient operations and better seller experiences through improved automation and clearer guidance.
 About The Team
 The classification engineering team is part of Amazon's Compliance & Safety Services organization, where we build systems that ensure product safety and regulatory compliance across Amazon's global marketplace.
We're responsible for multiple high-impact projects that collectively process large volumes of products. Our systems help Amazon meet regulatory obligations while reducing friction for sellers. The team culture emphasizes technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous learning from both senior and mid-level engineers.
You'll be part of building systems that help streamline compliance processes, working at the intersection of AI, regulatory technology, and large-scale distributed systems. Our mission is to make compliance more transparent, automated, and seller-friendly while maintaining high standards of safety and trust.
 Basic Qualifications
 Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
 Experience programming with at least one software programming language
 Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
 Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
 Preferred Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
 Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
 Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution
